allow: PowerShell(foreach \($c in @\('node','npm','python','py','git','docker','soffice'\)\) { $cmd = Get-Command $c -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($cmd\) { try { $ver = \(& $c --version 2>$null | Select-Object -First 1\) } catch { $ver = '\(version desconocida\)' }; "$c => $ver" } else { "$c => NO ENCONTRADO" } })

PowerShell($procs = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique; foreach \($p in $procs\) { Stop-Process -Id $p -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; "Detenidos en 3000: $\($procs -join ', '\)")

PowerShell(try { $p = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "http://localhost:8000/profiles" -TimeoutSec 20; "APA7 tiene rules: " + [bool]\($p | Where-Object { $_.id -eq 'apa7' }\).rules; "Cantidad de reglas APA7: " + \(\($p | Where-Object { $_.id -eq 'apa7' }\).rules\).Count } catch { "backend local no disponible: $_" })
